articleTitle: Using Firebase Cloud Messaging to Control Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The system proposed in this paper is new framework that can be utilized by any application programmer to use it for control mobile Application by using FCM technology Stand for (Firebase Cloud Messaging), which is supported by Google. It is a very powerful technology in sending Notifications to Mobile applications through data messages that can be used to change the behavior of mobile applications that installed on the smart phones. The system is designed to deal with more than one Firebase application at the same time and send data messages that designed by the programmer either by creating these data manually or to get this data from another environment. This system was designed to save the information of the applications that need to get control and data Message information can be store inside the local system database. The proposed system is working as Rest Clint to send information that containing JSON Format with key-value pairs, which is created inside the system itself or by using existing Data message from the Database, this messages can be send to specific application and it is possible to send this data Messages and information to a specific user or specific group of users in the same group using (subscribe topic) or all users of the Mobile App The system is designed using technology of Dot Net, Web Service, Firebase Cloud Messaging and sql server database that use to manage the Data and firebase applications. this Data Messages Can be sent to specific Mobile Application or Group of Mobile Applications using same Data message, the proposed system is solved the main problem of this paper that difficult to manage the orientation of the functions within the applications to make it easy and fast as much as passible.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of ONOS and Floodlight SDN Controllers based on TCP and UDP Traffic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is newly originated network architecture. SDN characterizes by flexible, dynamic, cost-effective, and convenient to manage. This article essentially provides two OpenFlow-enabled controllers, i.e., Floodlight controller and ONOS controller. A performance comparison of both controllers is tested over different network topologies (single, linear and tree). The analyzing of controllers based on some metrics such as transfer, Delay, bandwidth and jitter using an efficient network simulator called Mininet. The ONOS show better performance compared to Floodlight in both TCP and UDP traffic in network.

articleTitle: Enhanced Model for Cloud Data Security based on Searchable Encryption and Hybrid Fragmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Cloud computing is a new technology that transfer the computing process from personal computers into cloud servers over the internet. Nevertheless, as the client information data is stored in the cloud provider servers, the confidentiality of the information become a new concern. Different algorithms based on Encryption is presented previously to provide cloud clients with confidentiality. The main idea of encryption algorithms for cloud data is to permit cloud clients queries to be handled using encrypted data without decryption. This paper presents a new security mechanism using hybrid method of encryption algorithms and a distribution system to enhance cloud database confidentiality. A vertical fragmentation technique is adopted from alsirhani's model for distributing data over clouds. However, to overcome a weakness in alsirhani's model where compromises to a fragment can still make data meaningful. Instead, the proposed model uses a hybrid fragmentation technique to make data on fragments meaningless if compromised. The proposed model distributes the cloud database among the clouds using the provider views and level of confidentiality that is delivered by the employed encryption algorithms. To evaluate the proposed searchable encryption and hybrid fragmentation model, the study developed a Java application for simulating the hybrid cloud. The simulation combines public and private clouds; as essential processes is conducted inside the private cloud. The evaluation of the work was conducted by comparing the proposed model with existing solutions in query response and security characteristics. Preliminary results showed that the proposed searchable encryption and hybrid fragmentation model provides a secure mechanism that enhances data confidentiality in terms of faster response and additional security.

articleTitle: Sizing and Evaluation Analysis of Hybrid Solar-Wind Distributed Generations in Real Distribution Network Considering the Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In this paper, the optimal placement and rating of renewable energy resources (RER) including solar PV and wind units are assigned using efficient algorithm called Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) for power loss minimization. The uncertainty problems in electrical systems should be considered for efficient planning and operation by diminishing the risk of assigning the inclusion of Distributed Generators (DG). This work determines the optimal allocation of RER in the radial distribution grids (RDGs) considering the uncertainties for an actual radial grid of the East Delta Network. The simulation results confirm that the optimal inclusion of solar and wind units minimizes the power loss considerably. Moreover, the developed algorithm is effective to determine the optimal ratings and locations of hybrid solar-wind units in terms of reducing power loss considering the uncertainties.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Wind Farms Integrated with UPFC Using Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The unified power flow controller (UPFC) is employed for stability improvement and voltage regulation of power systems. Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) has learning capability to solve and estimate the best solution of nonlinear functions. This paper studies the ability of ANFIS to estimate the best values of control gains of UPFC for enhancing the performance of a blended wind farm (BWF) during three phase fault. In BWF, the fixed speed squirrel cage induction generators (SCIG) and variable speed doubly fed induction generators (DFIG) are blended. The performance of BWF with ANFIS UPFC is compared with two cases, firstly BWF with UPFC controlled by artificial neural networks (ANN) (ANN UPFC), secondly BWF without UPFC. The root mean square error, RMSE, is used to measure the performance of the studied cases. The results show that the ANFIS UPFC can improve the performance of BWF. The system is achieved using the Matlab- Simulink software.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of DG and Capacitor in Radial Distribution Systems Considering Load Variation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper provides an effective analytical approach for identifying the optimum places and sizes of the distributed generation (DG) and shunt capacitor (SC) in radial distribution system (RDS) in order to minimize the power losses and improve the voltages for all busses. First, using power loss sensitivity factor (PLSF) is suggested to use the most candidate buses to install DGs, SCs and DGs with SCs. The proposed analytical approach is then used to calculate the sizes of the sources from the chosen buses. The buses give minimum power losses are the best locations for the sources compared with others. The numerical simulations are carried out using IEEE 33-bus and 69-bus RDS to verify the performance of the proposed method, while the loads are changed from 50% to 150%. The obtained results are compared with other techniques to verify the effectiveness of the proposed analytical approach.

Author Keywords: power loss reduction & voltage profile improvement

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding mode control design for the 2-DOF robot arm manipulators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive sliding mode (ASMC) controller designed for a multi-inputs and multi-outputs (MIMO) robotic arm nonlinear manipulator system. The controller is designed based on Lyapunov theorem to achieve a robust trajectory tracking taking into consideration the system's uncertainties in addition to reducing the effect of chattering problem associated with the traditional sliding mode control. It's found that, even in the presence of the parameters' uncertainties, the performance of the proposed controller for the trajectory tracking is robust. Furthermore, chattering is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Sine Cosine Algorithm for Load Frequency Control Design of Two Area Interconnected Power System with DFIG Based Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper describes an important topic regarding with stability of the electrical grid, it is the load frequency control (LFC) problem. At any interconnected-areas of power systems, LFC problem must be solved to ensure system stability without any disturbance. When the amount of generating power is insufficient to meet the electrical load needs, frequency deviation is appeared with instability in power system. Doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) has the ability to support the power system with an additional inertia by supplying it with an extra active power. The studied system is a two-area thermal-thermal power plants with different participation level of DFIG at the first area. An exchanging power is flowing between neighboring areas in the studied system through a tie-line. The two power plants in each model are subjected to 2% load perturbations in each area. These load perturbations are applied for examining the ability of Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) technique to restore the stability of studied systems. when DFIG participation level is high, the optimum performance of power system is achieved. All time domain simulation results are carried out by MATLAB (R2015a) program for investigating the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Waste- to- Energy Production of Alternative Energy Source Using Landfill Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Recently, the world start suffering from energy resources depletion and energy demand has been a serious concern. Sudan confronts a problem to deal with fossil fuel resources limitation and the increasing of waste accumulation. Introducing new technologies such as waste to energy (WTE) may help to handle such concerns. The objective of this study was to design and construct a landfill cell to provide an appropriate technical solution for both waste and energy sectors, and also to measure landfill gas (LFG) and specially the CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> content that can be produced. The results showed the feasibility of this technology to produce a source of energy from municipal solid waste, which can be an alternative to fossil fuel. The gas analyzer GFM410 was used to analyze the extracted LFG contents, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> content varies in the range from 48% to 56% and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> vary in the range from 39% to 47.2%; Using LandGEM model ver. 3.02 to predict LFG contents for 10 years and results show the total LFG, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at 2019 are 0.025 Mg/year, 0.0067 Mg/year and 0.0185Mg/ year respectively which was the peak year, 0.0067 Mg/year was equivalent to 10.1 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/year for CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. Using LFG as fuel to run engines at WTE plant would help to reduce GHG emissions and usage of fossils fuel, landfill technology representing a proper solution for both energy demand and waste contamination problems; the key factors for this new technologies is to increase the environmental awareness among the people so they will start to treat waste as value energy source.

articleTitle: Arabic-Numbers Recognition System for Car Plates
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In the modern era, computers are used to automate most of the operations used to be done by humans. This leads to higher performance and low cost of operations. The field of traffic management is not an exception. In this paper, we propose an automatic license plate recognition system which can extract the license plate number of the vehicles using machine learning models and image processing algorithms. License plate recognition systems pass through three successive stages and differ in the techniques used to achieve the output. In this paper, Locating the license plate in a given image is the first stage. It is achieved using Faster Region-Based Convolutional Neural Network, which is capable of identifying regions with objects based on regions proposal network. It is also capable of classifying the detected objects. Second stage is the segmentation of the plate using image processing algorithms and final stage is to recognize the segmented digits using convolutional neural network model. Results reveal that the presented system successfully detects and recognizes the vehicle number plate on real images, achieving an overall accuracy of 93% with a total of 100 images.

articleTitle: Atom Search optimization Algorithm for Optimal Radial Distribution System Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In proposed paper, a recent swarm-based metaheuristic optimization algorithm named as atom search optimization algorithm (ASO) is applied for solving the optimal distribution system reconfiguring problem to reduce the network power losses. The topological structure of system is reconfigured more times until obtaining the optimum construction of the system for decreasing the total active power losses. ASO simulates the atomic movement in the nature and interaction forces between atoms or molecules where there are resulting interaction forces according to Lennard-jones potential and constraint forces produced from bond-length potential. The results proved the superiority and effectiveness of developed algorithm compared with many other methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hybrid Intrusion Detection and Prevention System for Flooding Attacks Using Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Computer networks are being attacked every day. Intrusion detection systems (IDS) are used to detect and reduce effects of these attacks. The currently used of hybrid intrusion detection systems that was base on signature and anomaly based detection techniques were became inefficient for detecting attacks because it have nearly less than or equal to 95.5% for the detection rate and 1.8% for false positive rate, nowadays these values are unsatisfied for the detection so that the needs to enhanced hybrid intrusion detection system has became the most important issues. In this study, the enhanced hybrid intrusion detection system has been proposed to provide better results with high accuracy of the detection rate and reduce the value of false positive rate that will done by proposing new method based on decision tree of data mining techniques that is based on C4.5 algorithm to show that the proposed model is more efficient and it gives better optimum results.

articleTitle: Controlling Drone–using IOT platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The main role of this work is to achieve internet of things on a drone model by adding a simple and capable to improvement processing unit on the Drone model. An internet of things based drone model is implemented. The Raspberry Pi plays the main role. The user communicates with the Raspberry over internet by virtual network computer viewer in order to send the commands to control the drone and get back data from the Raspberry. The Raspberry starts a python program that translates the commands given by the user and sends It to the assigned GPIO pin which sends the signal to the ESC to control the motors. The Raspberry Pi camera is used to send live video from the area of the drone to the user.

articleTitle: 10 GHz Investigation of Sudanese Dust Event Particles Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: For a heavy dust storm that hit Khartoum at March 29,30, 2018, eight samples from pre-determined locations are collected to study the suspended particle characteristics* In this experimental study the samples gathered are investigated to determine size, shape , chemical composition and electrical properties of dust samples*The shape of the prticles is obtained using field emission scanning electron microscope and it is obvious that the dust storm particles have irregular shape* Particle size and distribution are investigated using Nano Tec Laser Particle Sizer and it was found that the mean diameter of samples is equal to 47.08 μm and the size distribution is log nor mal* Chemical composition is carried out with Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence Spectro meter* SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is the major compound found in the sa mples* To estimate dust dielectric constant Looyenga model is used* The results are given and they conform with some of published results*

articleTitle: Series Parallel Cascaded H-Bridge Inverter Based on A Simlpe Staircase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper presents the main types of a series-parallel cascaded H-bridge inverter. It consists of H-bridge cells, and an inverter which output is a multilevel voltage by adding the dc voltage sources in series and parallel. A simple staircase modulation is used to obtain on-off of transistors used in series-parallel H-bridge multilevel inverter. The modulation technique used in this paper can calculate the independent switching angles more simply than the traditional method, and can be applied to all kinds of multilevel inverters. The proposed inverter topology results from implementation of optimum switching angles in low total harmonic distortion values in the phase and line voltage waveforms. The circuit configuration, theoretical operation, is also discussed in this paper. PSIM, PROTEUS-V8 based simulation results are obtained, which are consistent with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Steganography Aided with Compression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Steganography is one of the information hiding Techniques that hide a message inside another message without drawing any suspicion. In this research, multilevel steganography techniques proposed with two levels, level one text steganography, and level two is image steganography. In level, one uses a new approach that is based on the Pseudo-Random Number Generation (PRNG) to embed the secret message into a Cover-text that generated randomly. Level Two uses a cover image to embed the message by using the LSB insertion technique that produces the Stego-image. Between these levels, the compression process (Huffman Compression Algorithm) reduces the size of level one output and passed to level two. The model uses two secret keys at both ends for authentication. At the receiver side, different reverse operations have been carried out to get back the original information. A lot of experiment to test a variety of measurements such as the capacity and quality of the proposed model showed.

articleTitle: Vertical Handover E-TOPSIS Algorithm Mathematical Model using AHP and Standard Deviation Weighing Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The growing demand for the concept of Always Best Connected (ABC) has led to the rise of heterogeneous network. Vertical handover technique is the key to selection of the best network that satisfies the user and many algorithms have been introduced as a result of this. In this paper, an improved MADM algorithm known as Enhanced-TOPSIS is used in combination with two weighting methods AHP (background, conversational, interactive, and streaming traffic classes) and Standard deviation (SD) to select the best network. The results show that Wi-MAX is the network favored by applications using any traffic class.

articleTitle: Operating Cost Comparison of Sudan’s Power System Grid with and without NPP Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Nuclear energy has been seen as a clean, cheap and stable source of electricity worldwide. However, each country has its own reasons behind introducing nuclear energy to its energy mix. Regarding Sudan, nuclear energy will help to reduce the energy deficit and boost up the economy of the country by increasing available energy. However, the Nuclear power plant, NPP, has to be carefully operated to maintain the safety of the plant as well as the grid to which the plant will be connected. Additionally, and from an economical point of view, the grid operational cost must be kept as low as possible. This paper compares the operational cost of the Sudan's grid for a single day with and without the inclusion of the nuclear power plant while meeting the power system constraints and the nuclear power plant constraints. This shall be done by examining two scenarios; firstly, the operational cost of a single day (24 hours) for Sudan's grid without the nuclear power plant will be calculated and then it will be compared with the operational cost of the grid after nuclear power plant is connected. The calculation will be conducted by formulating a unit commitment problem for both scenarios. The results have shown that second scenario, with nuclear power plant being introduced, was economically better.

articleTitle: Energy optimization in WSNs using Successive Addition and Successive Reduction Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Power optimization is an important issue in wireless sensor networks, the objective of this research is to design and implement algorithms to optimize the power consumption for the network. Two methods have been proposed in this study. The first method is the Successive Addition Method, SAM, where the algorithm tries to build the operational sensor sets by incrementally adding sensors. The second is the Successive Reduction Method, SRM, where the algorithm removes sensors that have the largest overlap with other sensors in the set. The results of simulation showed that the two algorithms are able to choose the optimum sets and achieve the required levels of area coverage for the optimum total time. It is observed that the SAM outperforms the SRM at lower target coverage. However, the SRM's performance improves when the target coverage is higher.

articleTitle: Adopting Continuous Integeration and Continuous Delivery for Small Teams
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Continuous Integration is the practice of merging small code changes frequently rather than merging large number changes at the end of a development cycle. In addition, after each integration, the system should be re-built and re-tested to ensure that the system is still working after each change, and it's safe to build on top of it. Continuous delivery is software practice in which the software can be deployed to the market at any given time. Developing continuous integration and continuous delivery platform will solve a lot of problems in old agile methods such as increases time to find and fix bugs as testing process late, deploying software that has not been fully tested and shared testing resources which cases delivery delays, when multiple projects are ready for testing one project get tested and others are queued waiting for the testing resource to be released. Also continuous delivery guides development organization to build valuable software and to increase the number of releases. With all this benefits there are some problem obstructing companies from moving to the new platform, some of them are human factors such as human resistant to changes and other are technical such as moving to new platform require learning new tools and training. To help overcome these problems we need to develop simple platform which is more usable and easy to learn. Also some problems happen when applying CI/CD some of them related to testing and others related to integration. Testing problem are: ambiguous test result which is test results that doesn't guided the developers to finds bugs, which increases time to find and fix it; time consuming tests which require developers to waiting large amount of time for testing reports after each small changes, this waiting cause the developers to practice large commit (merging large number of changes) which slows the integration process. Slow integration mean large number of conflict lines, now instead of doing productive process developers wasting time to solve this conflicts. To overcome these problem we introduce a new way to configuring tests. As you see solving time consumes test will solve integrations problems. To reduce testing time we need to organize the test in such way that tests are more appointed and targeted to changed code only. This method enforces a concept called micro-pipeline. A micro-pipeline is group of testing blocks, each block is responsible for specific type of test for specific unit of code, connected together in such a way that passing the block tests triggers the next test block in series. When integration happen the developer specify test block which is responsible for testing made changes only. The idea behind micro-pipeline is to test affected part only.

articleTitle: Bridging the Gap between Service Oriented Architecture and Cloud Software as a Service
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Nowadays, Cloud Software as a Service (SaaS) and Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) have received increased attention as approaches to software development in distributed systems. Cloud SaaS is the most common model in cloud computing that provides software as service over internet to support the availability and scalability of services. While SOA is an architectural style that focuses on loosely coupled interaction between services to provide the reusability. In SaaS model, applications suffer from functions customization and reusability. On the other hand, SOA architecture suffers from many scalability issues. There is a need for a new model that tackle these issues. This research aims to bridge the gap between SOA and SaaS through designing a new model as an attempt to combine SOA and SaaS in one model and then leverage from SOA reusability and SaaS scalability. The proposed model has the structure of SaaS multi-tenant's applications with modified in computing and application code structure by applying the SOA concepts. The research followed an empirical study and case study methodology. The evaluation is carried out through designing a healthcare information system based on the proposed model. According to the evaluation results, the implementation of the proposed model on healthcare information system has increased the reusability and scalability of system.

articleTitle: Maximization of Power System Loadability by Optimal FACTS Allocation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In this paper, maximizing power system loadability is achieved through determining the optimal FACTS allocations. Thyristor Controlled Series Compensator, TCSC, and Unified Power Flow Controller, UPFC, are chosen and implanted in Continuation Power Flow, CPF, merged with Improved Moth Flame optimization, IMFO, technique. Single and multi-objective functions are formulated to check the developed algorithm performance. IEEE 30-bus system is used for validation, where the obtained results show the effectiveness and powerful of the algorithm for maximizing the power system loadability, reducing power losses, and minimizing voltage deviation & voltage stability index.

articleTitle: Cascaded H-bridge Multilevel Inverter Balancing for Energy-Power Based on VSG
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Multilevel cascaded H-bridge inverters allow direct connection without the presence of power transformers to medium-voltage distribution networks. The energy and power imbalance creates unexpected problems within this structure, which is designed to operate under balanced conditions. This paper presents cell and phase balance for power and energy of a 10-cell multilevel inverter cascaded H-bridge (CHB). The CHB inverter control for each stage leg used the type of phase-shifted carrier (PSCPWM). The control strategy based on the idea of a virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is used on the way to balance the power and energy distributed among cells in the same phase and between phases. Simulation result is presenting to verify the mathod for balance system. The results have been presented and carried out in MATLAB/SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: Video Security System for Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Due to the large-scale development of technology in the modern world, institutions, businesses and residential areas need to secure their facilities leading to the need for a security system. There are several ways to help increase the security; one of these methods is to install a surveillance security system. Conventional surveillance systems have disadvantages where they are often human-based, allocated a numerous number of video cameras to monitor the entire environment, and Collecting a large amount of video data requires considerable calculation and manpower to analyze. Broadly, the recorded video files consume much storage space and someone must always monitor to check whether events occurred or not in the surveillance zone. In order to eliminate these problems a need to use effective surveillance security system which only records when motion is detected, which is the purpose of this paper. The system analyzed of an “area of environment being monitored” through used Sum of Absolute Difference (SAD) algorithm to detect motion in real time. Where web camera captures the images which are analyzed to detect the motion (intervention) and generating alarm. The obtained results were satisfactory, where all intrusion scenes were detected without errors. Hence, storage requirement reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Enhancement of U-Net Performance in MRI Brain Tumour Segmentation using HardELiSH Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper proposes the usage of enhanced activation function to improve the performance of deep learning models used in MRI brain tumour segmentation. Activation function has a significant role in deep network stability, learning rate and accuracy of the resultant solution. The main advantage of this new activation function is the ability to provide more accurate results solving the problem of vanishing gradient in comparison to the common activation functions “ReLU”. Vanishing gradient affects the training rate and therefore, the weight updates and the overall network accuracy. This work aims to study the feasibility of increasing the accuracy of deep learning brain tumour segmentation using an enhanced activation function. In this study, U-Net deep learning model was chosen. A modified U-Net architecture was built for the segmentation task. Several enhanced activation functions were used besides the standard ReLU. The benchmark database used for the evaluation was BRAST 2015 dataset. The results showed that the HardELiSH activation function outperformed the standard ReLU activation function. This proves that the deep learning model performance in brain tumour segmentation can be enhanced with the choice of the activation function.

articleTitle: Design of A Simple and Low Cost Near InfraRed Imaging (NIRI) System for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Breast cancer is the second cause of mortality after lung cancer, and it seriously threats women's health. In developing countries, Mammogram is the currently available tool for breast cancer diagnosis. However, it is a relatively expensive device since it needs special room requirements for safety due to the usage of ionizing radiation, which is not safe, especially for pregnant women. Therefore, there is a need to develop a low-cost imaging device that can screen breast cancer in developing countries. Since there are differences in optical densities between normal and abnormal breast tissues at infrared wavelength range, a Near Infra-Red Imaging (NIRI) system is designed and phantoms experiments are implemented to show the ability of the system for detecting breast cancer. The results showed that our proposed system achieve the goals of an efficient, simple, cheap and safe NIRI system which can be used to fill the gap in the developing countries for breast cancer detection scanning, especially in distant and rural areas.

articleTitle: Build and Conquer: Solving N Queens Problem using Iterative Compression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The N queens problem is a very hot topic for research use. Nonetheless all previous algorithms that solved the N queens problem treat each order of it as if they are separate problems with no connection among them. The main idea of this paper is to connect the dots among various orders of the N queens problem and demonstrate that all orders of the N-queens problem are connected with each other. And then we propose an algorithm using iterative compression to solve the problem i.e., beginning from the solution of the least order of the problem and then by using the relation among different orders we add a queen in every iteration until we have the ${N}$ queens residing in the NxN board.

articleTitle: Simulation of Drug Release from Biodegradable and Erodible Polymers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This study utilized mathematical and computational method to create nanoparticles model with nano-size and high loading capacity, encapsulation efficiency, and controlled release rate with some numerical predictions to study the release rate and its relations with the nanoparticles properties via controlled release mechanisms for the slab, spherical and cylindrical geometries which have been simulated using different model equations. We identified the effect of both dissolution and the erosion mechanisms on the drug release rate from nanoparticles. The result shows that there was an inverse proportional relation between drug concentration and the surface erosion rate as one value has increased another value has decreased. On the other hand, there is a direct proportion relation between both of the matrix diameter value, the relative separation, the uniform initial drug concentration and the drug released amount as one value increased, the release rate also increased. Extensive analysis of the release of the drug was performed using several models and equations.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Cardiac Disorders in ECG Signal using Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Heart disease was and still one of the critical disease that may affect our normal heart activity. Electrocardiograph (ECG) which represent heart cycle contain many components in form of waves, intervals, segments etc. In years, many techniques were developed to detect heart disorder and in this paper a method of cardiac arrhythmia detection and classification was developed to differentiate between normal an abnormal ECG signals, this process had included three main steps, First as known all signals even it was biological or other need to remove all the noises that may contained in this case filters were designed to remove these noises, and each kind need specific filter to be remove for example band-reject filter with cutoff frequencies (57Hz-43Hz) was designed to remove power line interferences and band-pass filter with cutoff frequencies (0.05Hz-30Hz) was designed to remove patient motion and patient chest movement. In the next step variables were calculated and features were extracted using a technique called wavelet transform algorithm which decompose the signals using many functions called wavelets, the one had been used was daubechies, It used because it has similar formulation. The extracted features and parameters were used as an input to the final stage, which is the artificial neural network (ANN) algorithm which is an algorithm works like the human brain when dealing with specific tasks, also it gains knowledge by training and evolving. The used signals were downloaded from an online website Massachusetts Institute of Technology Beth Israel Hospital (MIT-BIH) arrhythmia database which used to train and test the classifier. Classifier performance was calculated using four statistical values accuracy (98.7), sensitivity (98.7), positive predicatively (98.6), specify (90.91). The results showed new illations and support implemented ideas which will help the researcher in the future to compare between the found results and the current one, so noticing the progress, all this was implemented using Mat Lab (R2014b) program.

articleTitle: Computational Modeling of Drug Release Profiles from Swellable Polymeric Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study particular mechanisms involved in the release process based on mathematical modeling approaches that were collected from the literature which was developed as a novel method. In this study, MATLAB software was used to simulate and characterize drug release rate and kinetics from swellable polymeric matrix devices with different geometries by conducted a comparison to illustrate, study and distinguish the effect of each factor of mathematical equations parameters on drug release profile. The result demonstrated that the polymer matrix swelling follows non-fickian diffusion or Anomalous diffusion mechanism in which the drug release follows both erosion and diffusion-controlled release. Clearly, the matrix swelling devices with the slab, spherical and cylindrical geometries were affected by the relaxation constant as the greater the value of the relaxation constant, the lower the release behavior of drug from matrix while they were not affected by the diffusion constant. Correspondingly, the simulation results validated the use of the mathematical models equations in the field of manufacturing drug delivery systems as it can facilitate the selection of an appropriate carrier system geometry for the drug and assist in the predetermining the drug release inside the body.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Dijkstra and A* Traffic Routing Algorithms in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: As the urban population grew and the dependence on transport increased, several urban problems emerged in the cities, including traffic problems such as traffic congestion, high levels of pollution, increased mobility time and traffic accidents. There are traditional methods solved these problems, such as creat new or expanding existing roads to ease congestion, giving a short-term solution, adversely affecting the environment, and attracting increased traffic for vehicles within cities. In this paper, we conduct performance evaluation and compare two vehicle routing algorithms based on realistic transfer simulations. By doing so, we can identify the best routing algorithm for use in transportation in Kassala city, in order to provide a reference to the management of traffic, researchers and others. The results show that the Dijkstra algorithm is better than A* algorithm based on the evaluation criteria used in the research, namely, mean travel time, mean speed, mean waiting time, and mean CO2 emissions.

articleTitle: Level Control Of Horizontal Cylindrical Tank
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper proposes fuzzy logic controller design to deal with non-linear process of horizontal cylindrical (HCT) tank to control the liquid level at specified set-point. This controller was implemented to increase the speed of the process and to decrease its steady state error. A comparison was made between the fuzzy logic controller and the conventional PI controller. The fuzzy logic controller showed an effective improvement in the performance. Design of both controllers was implemented using MATlab.

articleTitle: In Efficiency of New Horizontal Barcoded Staff Coding and Automatic Leveling Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Digital leveling instruments are commonly used for determining height differences between points. These instruments offer an automatic measuring algorithm for height based on vertically barcoded staff. In this research, a webcam was used to capture the image of a horizontally barcoded staff, the webcam is tethered to a raspberry pi to perform decoding of height measurement based on a new coding and decoding method. The methodology implemented in this paper consisted of coding method in which horizontally stacked barcodes staff generated beside decoding algorithm to perform an automatic height measurement. The proposed algorithm is tested with multiple accuracy staffs generated for the purpose of evaluation. The objective of this research is to evaluate the efficiency of the implemented system for measurement which is tested by using closed-loop leveling and found that 2mm accuracy staff closing error is found to be 4mm and could efficiently work for targeted distances of maximum of 45m, and 5mm accuracy closing error is 20 mm and could efficiently work for maximum distance of about 60m.

articleTitle: A robust and Adaptable Method for Moving the Mouse Cursor Based on Eye Gazing Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: with the growing number of computer devices and the increasing time we spent on interacting with such devices, we started to get a new techniques to ease the use of these devices and increase interaction efficiency. Eye gazing techniques allow the user to move the mouse pointer using his eyes. It also helps adults and children with cerebral palsy, spinal cord injuries, brain injuries, Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, multiple sclerosis and brainstem strokes. The objectives were achieved using a trained Haar classifier for the face Detection in addition to the gradient theory for pupil detection. Also there was a use of OpenCV library that provides a wide variety of functions that were also used to achieve the overall objectives. We experienced several methods forface detection and eye center localization and compare it with the suggested method in terms of accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Adaptive Beamforming Algorithms and Bit Error Rate Analysis for MU MIMO m mWave Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Multiuser-multiple input multiple outputs (MUMIMO) can provide a substantial performance for cellular networks by applying a beamforming technique to direct signals in specific required directions. Therefore, this paper presents a basic idea of steering the incoming signals into the signal of interest (SOI) and signal not of interest (SNOI) directions. Moreover, different adaptive beamforming algorithms such as least mean square (LMS), recursive least square (RLS) and constant module algorithm (CMA) are analyzed and evaluated regarding the interference cancelation and steering of incoming data signal. In this regard, to calculate the received output signal, the optimal weight elements of a uniform linear array (ULA) antenna are computed and updated based on the incoming array sensor signals. Furthermore, the paper shows the effect of the beamforming on a bit error rate (BER) when applied a different number of antenna elements at base station (BS). The simulation results confirm that the algorithms likely have the same performance in the interference cancelation. However, the RLS algorithm shows a little enhancement compared with SMI and CMA algorithms. Besides, the results indicate that the beamforming with the different number of antenna elements has a significant impact on the BER performance. Hence, this work can be extended to a higher frequency of mmWave communication with a massive number of antenna elements, which can meet requirement of fifth generation (5G) network systems.

articleTitle: Investigating the Probability Density Function of the Detected Intensity of Overlapping Laser Sources in an FSO Turbulent Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Free space optical (FSO) communication systems are an attractive alternative for wireless communication links. A turbulent FSO channel can be modeled by a gamma-gamma probability density function (pdf. However, when two or more overlapping lasers that have the same central frequency but have random polarization and phase angles, the gamma-gamma pdf cannot represent the intensity In this paper we investigate via Monte Carlo Simulation the effect of both the beat noise and turbulence on the detected pdf when a FSO system uses a number of overlapping lasers. Results show that the beat noise is the dominant source of noise, while a turbulent channel A gamma pdf can give a good approximation of the intensity when the number of overlapping lasers is greater than sixteen, otherwise, the empirical pdf is provides a better estimate.

articleTitle: Plans and Challenges of the Renewable Energy in Sudan
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Electrical energy is the basis of modern economic and social development for any country. Sudan is a large country with a population of about 40.7 million and used to be the largest country in Africa before split of South Sudan in 2011. Electricity generation in Sudan depends on hydro and thermal power. Average electricity demand increases by 11.5% annually and the consumption per capita is 376.6 kwh/year. Like many developing countries, Sudan suffers from a shortage of electricity generation and network expansion and about 35% of the population has access to supply. It has become necessary to exploit other energy resources, especially solar, to complement the other limited generation. Considering the abundance of solar energy resources in the country, solar power is becoming so competitive against conventional energy in Sudan especially for the remote areas. Wind generation is also part of the future generation's map with solar, to support hydro, thermal generation. This paper presents the plans and challenges of Renewable Energy Systems (RES) in Sudan with focus solar energy generations and some applications.

articleTitle: Impact of Different Locations of Integrating SCIG Wind Turbine into Distributed Network Using Continuation Power Flow Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Induction power generators are the most popular wind energy conversion systems (WECS) because they do not require synchronization units. However, they always draw a significant amount of reactive power during startup. Consequently, wind power integration into distribution networks may lead to challenges relating to voltage stability issue. This paper assessed the impact of installing a squirrel cage induction generator (SCIG) at different positions on the proposed system. The static continuation power flow (CPF) strategy has been employed to detect the optimal placement of SCIG wind turbine in the power system. The proposed approach examined the system voltage stability by identifying the weak transmission lines and the corresponding buses. The stability assessments were carried out on the IEEE 14 bus test system by the use of PSAT simulation software. A better voltage profile, maximum loading point (MLP) and power losses reduction were obtained.

articleTitle: Design of A Simple and Low Cost Electrical Impedance Tomography System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) is a new imaging technique that has the ability to image human body without prolonged exposure to radiations. Developing countries like Sudan suffers from the availability of imaging devices due to its high cost and its danger to health due to the use of ionizing radiation. This problem can be solved by designing a simple and low cost radiation free medical imaging system. We have designed an Arduino-based EIT system for radiation free medical imaging. This system consists of AC voltage generator, Voltage Controlled Current Source, 16 electrodes and an automatic electrode switching module. Control of the system is achieved by Arduino microcontroller which decreases the overall cost of the system while adding simplicity to the design. The system results in 208 voltage measurements which are processed in MATLAB interfaced with EIDORS (Electrical Impedance and Diffuse Optical Tomography Reconstruction Software) software to reconstruct the image. Our EIT system cost and performance are clearly discussed with tables and figures, it costs only about 63.61 $, have percent error of 13.15% and reconstructs images with high resolution making it possible to have an alternative cheap, accurate and simple EIT system for radiation free medical imaging.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of SDN Controllers in Ofnet Emulation Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Ever since the Software Defined Networking (SDN) was introduced, it has led into the discovery of several controllers, which have been consistently improved by researchers to overcome many constraints. For the fact that there are many types of controllers in SDN it was necessary to find out which controller has the best performance. To the best of our knowledge, there has been no comprehensive compression discussion about floodlight and OpenDaylight controller in the literature. The aim of this research is to evaluate two different types of a controller named Floodlight and OpenDaylight according to various parameters. The compression based on various parameters such as new flow generation, average setup latency, open flow massages to/from the controller, flow misses to the controller and Central Processing Unit (CPU) utilization in the Ofnet platform program. It was found that the floodlight controller is outperforming the OpenDaylight controller in small occupying memory size and less CPU utilization. Furthermore, it contains a less number of messages in packages, and the new flow generation is static. However, the OpenDaylight controller is outperforming the floodlight controller in average setup latency.

articleTitle: Development Surface Morphologies of Porous Hydroxyapatite Scaffold Hydrothermally for Bone Regeneration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The development of calcium phosphate (Ca/P) surface structure is good to choose of bone substitute scaffolds, which is a favor for bone regeneration. In this study hydroxyapatite (HA) porous scaffolds were produced by the accumulation of HA fibres and treated hydrothermally in a calcium phosphate solution to form new morphology. A rodlike comprise a flower-like morphology were from on the surface of Ca-HA scaffold. The surfaces of the treated scaffold were investigated by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and x-ray diffraction (XRD). Moreover, cell culture results showed that the endothelial cells (EC) could spread on the surfaces of the treated scaffold (Ca-HA) more than HA scaffolds (control).

articleTitle: A Simple Malaria Transmission Model Applied to DRC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Malaria is endemic in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and it is one of the most severe diseases in the country. In this paper, we develop and analyze malaria transmission model with saturated incidence rate. The basic reproduction number, R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>, was calculated by the next generation technique. The model has a malaria-free equilibrium (MFE) which is locally asymptomatically stable when R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> <; 1. After that, we simulated the malaria data of Democratic Republic of the Congo that was reported by World Health Organization and predict the trends of the disease in the future. Our simulation results show that the malaria is endemic disease in the country. Moreover, we perform sensitivity analysis of R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>. According to our simulation and sensitive analysis results, we give some suggestions to reduce and control the disease in DRC.

articleTitle: Mitigation of SMIB Oscillations Using PSS Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In this paper a technique dependent on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) calculation is exhibited to find the ideal parameters of Power System Stabilizer (PSS), instead of classical control approaches. A fitness function based on Critical Damping Index (CDI) has been used as an optimization problem to get the PSS optimal parameters. PSS controller combined with Single Machine Infinite Bus (SMIB) system is used in order to mitigate any oscillations occurred in the system. The eigenvalues and damping ratios for the electromechanical modes have been calculated and tabulated for different cases of operation using MATLAB/SIMULINK. All simulation outputs proved that the capability of the PSS based on PSO in mitigation the system oscillations is better than PSS based on conventional control methods. Also the results show that the electromechanical damping ratios increased from 2.2113% without PSS control to 20.58% for system with PSS based on conventional control method and to 65.94% for system with PSS based on PSO Algorithm. Also the settling time reduced to 4 seconds for system with PSS based on conventional control method and to 2 seconds for system with PSS based on PSO Algorithm. NEPLAN software has been used to prove the effectiveness, robustness, and validity of the designed PSS system based on PSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Zinc oxide (ZnO) Solar Cells Based on Dye And Polymers Materials and Dye Synthesized Solar Cells (DSSC)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Comparison between PCBM: P3HT Inverted polymers materials and dye synthesized solar cells (DSSC) has been done. So as to improve the efficiency and performance of solar cell, zinc oxide (ZnO) seed layer and ZnO nanorod have been synthesized using Sol-gel and hydrothermal methods respectively. Due to the exceptional luminescent, extensive emission band in the yellow-green zone, short-wavelength lasing, cathode luminescence, the common nonlinear optical properties of II-VI semiconductors and optoelectronic properties of Zinc oxide (ZnO), has been used for photo anodes in the inverted polymer solar cell and P-type material in the dye synthesized solar cell. When we used Zinc oxide (ZnO) as photo anodes based on polymer materials it is found that the efficiency of solar cell has become better than when we used dye synthesized solar cell.

articleTitle: Secure Data Using Quick Response Code
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Keeping confidential data and hiding it from unauthorized people has become a real challenge nowadays, cryptography play a major role for secured data transfer. Quick Response Code (QR Code) are tow-dimensional barcodes that encode data. QR code can be used in many fields such as business, marketing, educations, information security, authentication etc. They are able to encode information in both row and column direction, thus able to encode Large amount of information. In this paper, a suggested cryptography technique Depend on Quick Response code (QR code), this technique encrypts secret message by using Advanced Encryption Standard algorithm (AES), then hide secret message in Quick Response code, and is saved as black and white image. Arnold transform was then applied to the Quick Response Code, which performs the scrambling operation by alteration the pixel Placements of an QR code image randomly, finally the Encrypted Arnold transform image is then decomposed into five coefficients using the Shearlet transform, Shearlet have been applied to image for enhancement. results of the experiment show that the proposed method has more security and enhances the confidentiality.

articleTitle: LabVIEW based Fuzzy Logic Controller for PLC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This project aims to design fuzzy logic controller for PLC using LabVIEW software. Since LabVIEW software replaced almost all physical instruments by virtual instruments which makes analysis and design easier. Similarly PLC software on the other hand replaced contactors and other switching devices with compact software based device. In this project fuzzy logic controller is designed on LabVIEW particularly for tank water level control. The inputs to fuzzy logic controller are water level in the tank and outflow rate are taken by the help of PLC from the tank level sensor and flow rate sensor. LabVIEW access sensor values using NI OPC-Server. NI OPC-Server connect LabVIEW and PLC. Then this inputs are analyzed on LabVIEW. After analyzing the inputs fuzzy logic controller decision is transferred to PLC which then manipulate the actuator in this particular case the DC pump driver. The simulation results shows promising performance, while hardware experimentation shows that it is possible to control PLC without using any PLC programming software with LabVIEW.

articleTitle: The Impact of Service Quality on Customer Satisfaction in Location Based Service : (Mishwar and Tirhal as Case Studies)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Nowadays mobile services are regarded as a fresh marketing implementation with rapid growth in the use of mobile technology. This results in a unique type of service implementation; jointly, these services are known as location-based services (LBSs). LBS is defined as a service providing the mobile device location and other related information services, which, when collected, provide additional value to users. The competition in mobile services is increasing, only providing mobile services is not enough to achieve competitive advantage. The aims of this paper is to identify the factors of service quality in mobile commerce and to test the connection between these factors and its effect on customer satisfaction in LBSs in Sudan. To collect information from users who have experience with LBS applications, an online questionnaire was used. A total of 410 replies have been gathered. The information obtained from the survey questionnaire were analyzed quantitatively using the Social Science Statistical Package (SPSS Version 16). The outcome shows that there are five factors affecting customer satisfaction, namely ease of use, responsiveness, system availability, reliability and application design. Responsiveness and Ease of use are the most significant factors that affect customer satisfaction. Furthermore, the relatively significant dimension in the measurement of customer satisfaction remain ease of use. This result will serve car booking service providers to focus more on ease of use issues in using such applications and then make improvement accordingly. Limitations and instructions are provided for future studies.

articleTitle: Application of optimization Algorithms for the Improvement of the Transient Stability of SMIB Integrated with SSSC Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: The property of using Static Synchronous Series Compensator (SSSC) as a transient stability solution has been carried out in this paper. Designing a controller of SSSC has been performed using a Particle Swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) code for a machine connected to the infinite busbar. The purpose of using an optimization algorithm is to find the optimum parameters of the controller by minimizing the time domain of the objective function. The deviation in rotor speed has been formulated as an objective function. The paper presents many scenarios to check the robustness of using PSO optimization algorithm as a parameter searching tool. In other words, stabilized responses with the help of PSO were compared with conventional control approaches typically using phase compensation technique. The responses have been checked for different fault locations and different fault types. Using the PSO algorithm proves its capability of improving the transient stability of the system as it surpasses the performance of conventional phase compensation methodology.

articleTitle: Intra Rack Traffic Communication and Peers aware Placement Algorithm for Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Clouds composed of a collection of resources but in a virtual form which can be provisioned on demand and depending on the cloud customer's needs. Cloud computing customers are in continuous increase which leads to massive resources demand. The process of resource placement efficiently has become a critical problem to be solved in the cloud data center to satisfy the cloud customers demand with low cost for the cloud provider. Over the last eight years, the placement of the virtual machines in cloud environment was a major research subject. Different algorithms have been proposed to achieve the optimal placement results. The majority of these algorithms focused on the optimization based on the CPU and memory as resources, while not giving considerable attention to the network. Few algorithms considered the network communication in the data center but most of them were mono objective. This paper represents a joint objective network communication aware VM placement algorithm, which aims to reduce the intra traffic communication in the cloud data center. This algorithm called Intra Rack Traffic Communication and Peers aware algorithm (IRTCP). The IRTCP has proved better results compared to the common algorithms and the initial placement.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Wireless Data Acquisition System for Fully Interconnected Medical Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Considering the problem of miss reference database for previous patient's data and miss interconnection between the medical environment units includes the physician, pharmacy, laboratory, etc... This paper aims to provide an interconnection between the medical environment units and physiological data which describe the conditions of his/her health to provide an important monitoring for the patient veracity. The proposed system consists of two main parts: data entry and querying system and wireless monitoring and acquisition system. The first part is a desktop application with database in the server. The second part consists of two wireless units: patient unit and hospital unit. The patient unit using the wireless sensors which collect the physiological parameter which are (temperature, blood pressure, heartbeat, and oxygen saturation) and forward it to the hospital unit through the Radio Frequency (RF) module, The hospital unit receives the physiological data from the patient unit through the RF module and then the hospital server updates the database by the physiological data which is considered as connecting point between the system parts. The experiential tests of the system were applied to insure the accuracy and integrated linking between the medical environment and patient data. In addition, using this system will help the doctor continuously monitors the physiological signals of patients in real-time. The proposed system was developed simulated and successfully verified. The collected data, using such system, could be useful for further bio-statistical analysis.

articleTitle: The Integrated History_based Prediction for Future Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Future communications technology is introduced to meet the explosive demand for high-speed data rate from a mobile broadband user. The heterogeneity of the wireless networks involves the integration of small cells for the demand for high data rate and good QoS, to support multimedia streaming at precision levels. However, seamless mobile access is a major challenge in next-generation networks. Many research trends were introduced to enhance the performance of handover to upgrade towards the future. However, prediction schemes are considered to be as a promising direction that solves many mobility issues. Knowing a user's next cell allows more efficient resource allocation and enables new location-aware services. By anticipating the target cell for the user's movement, the resource allocation can be performed before the actual handover, thus can reduce delays in resource allocation and finally can reduce the latency. In this paper, we proposed an integrated mobility prediction. The prediction scheme considers the regularity and randomness in the user behavior through using local and global profile. The simulation works reveal outperformance in prediction accuracy, unnecessary handover, and delay.

articleTitle: Development of An Emperical Model for Dust Storm Attenuation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper proposes an specific sand and dust storm fade estimation model. The proposed model is based on an empirical assessment of the impacts of the dust and sand storms on a terrestrial link operating at21 GHz. The developed model is simple and reliable with minimum number of input parameters. Validation of the model with measurements at frequency range 14 GHz to 40 GHz showed close agreement.

articleTitle: A Hybrid DW Design Method Using a Semantic Resource
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Data warehouse (DW) plays an important role in organizations as it supports the decision makers to take the right decisions in time. The hybrid DW design approach acquires acceptable agreement between researchers in DW area. As well, using ontology is a helpful factor for solving the heterogeneity problems. Unfortunately, despite these successes, the reconciling process between business requirements and data source remains a great challenge for DW designers. In this paper, we propose a method for reconciling business requirements with data source. Our approach distinguishes from existing ones in that it: i) bases on natural language for requirements elicitation; ii) uses a WordNet as a semantic resource to solve the heterogeneity problems; iii) automates the generation of the reconciling process; iv) allows the DW designer intervene to validate the generated multidimensional model. We developed a software prototype to demonstrate the simplicity of our approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Improve the Retrieved Multilingual Documents Score
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: With an ever-increasing number of resources on the Web, different language resources such as newspapers, magazines, and articles have become available. This demands for an improved technique in the information retrieval to extirpate the communication barrier among languages. Search engines are the cornerstones for informational contents and the link between the two parties of publishing and retrieval of content. Moreover, the search for information is no longer narrowed to users of the native language of the original source. Most of the non-English users such as Arabic speakers are unable to express the terms in their own language. Also, the terminologies written in the native language of the source are acquired from the English language. This challenge drives users to use mixed terms (multilingual terms) to get better results, especially in the scientific domain. This paper attempts to address the problem of documents retrieval using multilingual queries. When users use mixed queries, the results of the multilingual documents will dominate the top of the retrieved documents rather than other relevant documents, and the scores of the mixed documents obtain extra weight values that are not really part of their actual weighting value. This paper proposes a novel method to improve the results of the retrieved documents by adjusting the score of multilingual documents. For experiments, we used a mixed test collection containing mixedlanguage documents (Arabic and English). The results showed that the proposed method led to an enhanced performance in documents retrieval from multilingual queries which made them relevant, effective and accurate thus proving that our approach is more reliable than other traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model That Describes the Transmission of African Swine Fever Through Ticks and Infected Pigs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: African swine fever(ASF) is an infectious viral disease for domestic pigs and wild pigs that is caused by a DNA called African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV), which is present in several parts of Africa, Europe, Asia and recently in China and Mongolia. The disease causes high mortality rate in pigs which has significant socioeconomic effects on the country. The aim of this paper is to determine the influence of the ticks and infected pigs on the transmission of the disease. We formulate a mathematical model that describes the transmission of Africa swine fever between the ticks and pigs and also among the pigs themselves. The basic reproduction number RO was obtained using next generation matrix and the existence of equilibria was investigated. Our numerical simulation results with numerical example shows that, there is an effect of the ticks and infected pigs on the spread of the disease and the infected pigs can recover from the disease. Furthermore, the reactive rate, infection rate from infected ticks to susceptible pigs, progression rate from exposed pigs to infectious pigs, the recovery rate from carrier pigs to susceptible pigs and tick's growth rate have effects on transmission and controlling of the disease. According to our simulation results we made some suggestions to control and reduce the spread of African swine fever.

articleTitle: Automatic Satellite Antenna Alignment in X, Y Co-Ordinates
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: this paper presents a design to align a satellite antenna automatically to a specific satellite. Firstly, the initial system designed was built using Proteus and Bascom over ID. Secondly, that antenna was motorized with two DC Motors, one for horizontal movement and the other for vertical movement. The controller was used to control the movement of DC motors to move the two motors in a pattern of pulses. When the controller gets a good signal level, It will save motors positions in its EEPROM. This is done according to a specific program built in the microcontroller memory. The controller used in this system was avr atmega 32 programmed by using BASCOM AVR ID. Then test and evaluation process was done for the proposed system. Finally, conclude that the use of the proposed solution makes the alignment process easy and quick. The outcome of the simulation is appropriate to what is expected from using this technique.

articleTitle: Voltage Profile Enhancement in Middle District of Sudan Electric Grid Using Neplan® Software
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: In this study the voltage profile of middle district of Sudan Electric Grid is investigated. The transmission network along the middle district area serve a high power generated from Roseires Dam, Setete Hydro Power Station, Umdabakir Thermal Power Station, Ethiopian Interchange and deliver the supplied power to heavy industrial and residential areas in Maringan, Giad, Albagair and Soba through 220kV double circuits lines. These two routes between Showak-Giad and Umdabakir-jabelawlia suffer from excessive voltage drop when heavy loaded at peak load and flood season. For instance, three scenarios were taken to improve voltage profile of middle district. These are: (i) Add SVC at Maringan 220kV bus, (ii) Replacing the existing single conductor with bundle geometry, (iii) Add a new double circuit between Gadarif-Maringan. Power-Voltage (PV) and Reactive Power-Voltage (QV) curves plotted for each case to illustrate the paper problem, also load flow results and Voltage Change Index (VCI) used for comparison. The simulation was carry-out using NEPLANo software.

articleTitle: Lateral and Longitudinal Controllers Design for a Fixed Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: Since the time when flying became a reality, there was a tendency to think about controlling airplanes autonomously. Autopilots design and implementation have gained a huge concentration from researchers all around the globe since the early beginnings of the past century. This is because of the major benefits that such systems provide which range from sparing humans' lives from hazardous situations, to having the ability to record experimental data. Although there are numerous kinds of autopilots, this paper comprises a successive loops methodology, which is used for designing PID controllers for both longitudinal and lateral behaviors of a six degrees of freedom, fixed wing Ultrastick25-e airplane. Then the proposed design approach is simulated and tested on MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis of Downdraft Gasification Integrated with SOFC for Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Control, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering (ICCCEEE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the integration of biomass gasification (downdraft fixed bed reactor using air as a reactor agent fed with olive leaves as a fuel) with SOFCs (Solid Oxide Fuel Cells) which are prospective technology and effective in the production of electrical power with high efficiency. Cycle-Tempo® simulation has been used to study the developed system. The developed system is capable of providing electrical power of 424.06 kWei, 77.60 kWth of thermal power and net electrical efficiency 44.699% at SOFC exit temperature 800, 1500A/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of Current density and fuel utilization factor 74.39%.
